name: Pentagon-free graphs without independent 9-sets (Ramsey number R(C5,K9))
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 35 containing no 5-cycle (as a subgraph) and no independent set of 9 vertices, both checked exactly. Maximize n. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(C5,K9) > n; the best known has 32 vertices and no valid graph has more than 35.

sources.locator: Bernard Lidický and Florian Pfender, Semidefinite Programming and Ramsey Numbers (2021). Crossref record inspected; Radziszowski's survey DS1.18 (Table Vb) inspected: 33 <= R(C5,K9) <= 36 with the upper bound from Lidický and Pfender's flag-algebra computations; the lower bound is attained by eight disjoint copies of K4. The conjecture R(Cn,Km) = (n-1)(m-1)+1 covers only n >= m, so this case is open. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(C5,K9) > n; the best known has 32 vertices and no valid graph has more than 35.
